# Syndigo: Data Unlocked\. Potential Unleashed\.

> Centralize data, optimize content, and accelerate time to market with product experience management, product information management, and master domain management\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v28.6, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Pages
- [Product Information Management \(PIM\)](): Syndigo PIM is an integrated solution that streamlines data management\. Accurate, syndication\-ready content accelerates time to market, optimizing performance across all channels\.
- [Target\+ Ratings and Reviews Program]()
- [Resources]()
- [Contact Us](): Make every product shine from creation to checkout: Syndigo unlocks your data, powering exceptional product experiences and driving growth
- [Product Data Readiness Center]()

## Posts
- [Beyond the Package: Turning Wellness Data into Better Product Discovery]()
- [What Is Agentic PXM? The Operational Shift Behind the Agentic Commerce Revolution](): Learn what Agentic PXM is, how it powers agentic commerce, and why product data and AI workflows are key to future growth\.
- [Future\-Proof: How Brands \& Retailers Win with Agile Product Content](): Find out how product content, AI use, and UGC influence shopping decisions\. Insights from 1,800 consumers across the U\.S\. and Canada\.
- [Fueling Modern Product Experiences](): Discover why GDSN remains essential for modern product experiences, omnichannel commerce, and AI\-driven discovery in the future of retail\.
- [Too Many Channels\. Too Much Complexity\. ](): At the same time, managing product content across channels is getting harder\. New channels, changing retailer requirements, and AI\-driven discovery are pushing traditional workflows past their limits\. At the center of all this is product experience: how product data shows up, performs, and stays consistent wherever buyers encounter it\.

- [Syndigo Connect Europe 2026 \- Agenda]()
- [Food \& Nutrition Conference \& Expo \(FNCE\) 2026]()
- [Agenda]()

- [Europe Connect 2026]()

## News
- [You’re Not Deploying an Agent\. You’re Deploying a Liability\.]()
- [Brands risk overlooking data challenges behind Sunrise 2027]()
- [Syndigo Named a Leader in the Inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Product Information Management Solutions]()
- ["No\-Regret Work" for the AI Shopping Era \- with Syndigo's Leah Allen]()
- [The Product Experience Playbook: Winning Across the Physical, Digital \& AI Shelf]()

## Partners
- [Aprimo]()
- [Blue Yonder]()
- [Microsoft](): Syndigo is a leader in cloud\-native MDM, PIM, content syndication, and analytics that help organizations unlock experiences using their data with intelligent insights, automation, and their multi\-domain SaaS solution\. Syndigo provides a suite of data and content management solutions leveraging Microsoft and Azure technology, resulting in seamless deployment and operation\.  
- [Shopify]()
- [Axite]()

- [Urgency Messaging]()
- [Scarcity Messaging]()
- [Specialty Retailers]()
- [AI in Retail]()
- [FOMO Marketing]()

## Additional Partners
- [Agne](): AGNE has selected Syndigo as their GDSN data pool provider, reinforcing AGNE's commitment to accurate, standardized product data and efficient supplier collaboration\. If you’re already publishing GDSN content to AGNE, confirm that you are publishing your complete product catalog to Recipient GLN: 0860002872001\.
